findings.title: Materials' 50-point lens gap signals earnings cliff
findings.body: Materials sits at the 36th percentile on forward earnings but the 87th on trailing, a 50-point split that implies 110 percent earnings growth. The market is pricing a near-doubling of profits that would make today's trailing multiple look like a bargain.

findings.title: Health Care's 97th percentile forward multiple defies history
findings.body: Health Care's forward P/E of 19.81 is at the 97th percentile of its five-year range, yet the trailing multiple is only at the 76th. Analysts are underwriting 79 percent earnings growth — a bet that margins expand sharply from an already rich starting point.

findings.title: Utilities' forward optimism clashes with trailing reality
findings.body: Utilities' forward P/E sits at the 28th percentile while its trailing multiple is at the 2nd, a 26-point gap despite just 4 percent expected earnings growth. The market is paying up for stability at a time when the sector's reported earnings are near historic lows.
